name: One REIT, Inc.
summary: One REIT, Inc. owns Mizuho REIT Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the Asset Management Company). The firm is a member of the Mizuho Financial Group, as its asset management company, and sets middle-sized office buildings as its focal investment target while incorporating other office buildings, etc., aiming to construct a portfolio that both ensures stable income in the medium to long term and exhibits growth potential.
